name: Spišské Hanušovce (Slovakia)
description: Divided per saltire into blue at the hoist and bottom and dark green at the top and fly, with a yellow saltire, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature S-89/1994.
